verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM supports custom agent skills and publishes a developer guide for building them. Those are developer building blocks, not proof of a living community ecosystem. Nothing in the pack shows a published skills, plugins or presets marketplace or hub, its size (let alone thousands of items), or active third-party maintainers.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers
